protocol: Sequential isolated workers; warm synchronized samples; every trial checked against the original pencil, complete analytic requested space, eigenvalues and mass orthogonality at unchanged 1e-8 bounds. Setup/capture/reference/validation excluded and recorded separately. Native CPU factorizations are for this cube fixture only. CuPy generalized LOBPCG uses a supplied cuDSS SPD preconditioner; generalized SM and CG on indefinite shifted systems are explicit unsupported routes. Full Warp counts and fresh native CuPy absolute stopping residuals are required in addition to common physical gates; vendor graph transfers are reported separately. Failed and timed-out results are retained, never counted as speedups.
